Remark
↗ def:riemannian-distance

Definition 15 uses $C^1$ curves, while Lee uses admissible curves. Neither class contains the other. The infima agree: admissible curves can be reparametrized with zero velocity at corners without changing length, and $C^1$ curves can be approximated in length by regular curves. This equivalence is not used below, where distance always means Definition 15.
